concerns.location: plan.md:Phase & Task Breakdown -> 1 Synthetic Composition Generation
concerns.text: The plan relies on a deterministic synthetic composition dataset (see step 1 Synthetic Composition Generation) despite Principle VI of the project constitution, which is non‑negotiable and requires raw ion composition measurements to be stored unchanged. The plan only notes a *pending* amendment to allow synthetic data, but the amendment has not been approved, so the current workflow violates the Composition Data Integrity requirement.
